subject: Sapphire Health: CAIQ mapping workshop & artifact sprint plan
messages:
From: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@sapphirehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: alyssa.park@sapphirehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick response in our kickoff. Sapphire would like to schedule a focused workshop to walk through the CAIQ mapping and identify which artifacts we need to hand off during the sprint. Goal: complete the CAIQ mapping and secure sample log access so our internal security team can sign off prior to procurement.

A few things up front:
- We have three systems in scope (API gateway, ingestion pipeline, and customer-facing UI).
- We prefer a two-hour working session where we pair on the spreadsheet and split action items into an "artifact sprint" for the following week.

Available times next week: Tue 4/27 10:00–12:00 PDT, Wed 4/28 14:00–16:00 PDT, or Thu 4/29 08:00–10:00 PDT.

Also: do you need sanitized logs or will a manifest + selective samples suffice?

Attaching a short system inventory (attachment: sapphire_system_inventory.csv - 3KB).

Thanks,
Laura
Senior IT Risk Manager
Sapphire Health

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@sapphirehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sapphire Health: CAIQ mapping workshop & artifact sprint plan

On 2027-04-25 09:12 PDT Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@sapphirehealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan —
>
> Thanks for the quick response in our kickoff. Sapphire would like to schedule a focused workshop to walk through the CAIQ mapping and identify which artifacts we need to hand off during the sprint.

Thanks Laura — that works. We recommend the Tue 4/27 10:00–12:00 PDT slot so we can follow with the artifact sprint starting Wed. Agenda proposal below.

Pre-work we will drop before the workshop:
- CAIQ mapping template (pre-filled where we can) — attachment: sapphire_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx
- Redwood SIG playbook (short-runbook) — attachment: redwood_sig-playbook.pdf
- Sample logs manifest template — attachment: sapphire_sample_logs_manifest.csv

Questions:
1) For logs: if you can provide a manifest with sample filenames and whether they contain PII, that helps us scope redaction. Full sanitized samples are ideal but a manifest + quick samples are ok for initial sign-off.
2) Who will own the artifact sprint on the Sapphire side? (name + email)

I'll include Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate the artifact sprint cadence and Irene (Security) for any deeper CAIQ clarifications.

Proposed agenda for the 2-hour workshop (Tue 4/27 10:00–12:00 PDT):
- 10:00–10:15: introductions, scope, and success criteria
- 10:15–11:00: CAIQ mapping walkthrough (live)
- 11:00–11:30: artifact & log sample identification; redaction checklist
- 11:30–12:00: sprint owner assignments and timeline (deliverables + upload method)

Can you confirm the Tue slot and provide a primary owner? If Tue works I’ll send calendar invite + Drive folder and temporary SFTP instructions for sample upload.

— Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@sapphirehealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@sapphirehealth.com>, tom@secvendor.com
Date: 2027-04-25T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sapphire Health: CAIQ mapping workshop & artifact sprint plan

Jordan — thanks for the clear agenda. Tue 4/27 10:00–12:00 PDT works for the team.

Sapphire artifact sprint owner: Alyssa Park (that’s me) — alyssa.park@sapphirehealth.com. I will coordinate internal SMEs and the log access.

Regarding logs: we can provide a manifest first (I attached a short manifest: sapphire_sample_logs_manifest.csv) and two small sanitized samples from the API gateway (no customer identifiers). If you need any specific fields removed, please send a redaction checklist.

Tom Briggs from our security consulting partner will join the workshop and may ask for additional evidence types (config snapshots, backup retention policy).

See you Tue.

— Alyssa
IT Compliance Lead
Sapphire Health

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sapphire Health artifact sprint logistics

Jordan / team —

Nice — I’ll run the artifact sprint logistics once Alyssa confirms owners for each artifact. Quick runbook I’ll publish to the Drive folder before the workshop:
- "Artifact sprint owners.xlsx" (attachment: artifact-sprint-owners.xlsx) with columns: artifact, owner, due date, upload path
- Preferred upload: shared Drive folder (link to be created by you, Jordan) for documents; SFTP for larger log bundles (>100MB).

Action items I’ll cover in the workshop and then unblock post-call:
- Create Drive + temp SFTP stub and share credentials (owner: Marissa) — ETA: by 4/26 11:00 PDT
- Provide redaction checklist (owner: Irene) — ETA: by 4/26 EOD
- Confirm CAIQ mapping gaps and assign artifacts (owner: Jordan + Alyssa) — ETA: end of workshop

Irene: can you prep a 1-page redaction checklist that covers common log fields we ask to remove for SOC2/SIG reviews (PII, tokens, internal IPs)? Keep it prescriptive so their engineers can sanitize quickly.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redaction checklist and evidence expectations

On Tue Apr 27 10:15, I’ll cover the redaction checklist briefly. Draft notes I’ll push to the Drive folder:
- Remove direct customer identifiers: name, email, phone, customer_id fields
- Mask tokens, API keys, session ids (replace with "<REDACTED>")
- Strip internal IP ranges (10.x.x.x, 172.16.x.x, 192.168.x.x)
- Keep timestamps and right-sized context lines for event tracing

I’ll include sample redacted log snippets in the Drive folder so their SRE can copy/paste a sanitizer. If they prefer, we can provide a small Python sanitizer snippet during the sprint.

Also: we prefer the initial artifact drop by 2027-04-28 17:00 PDT so the security review can start asynchronously.

— Irene Choi
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Briggs <tom@secvendor.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, laura.jenkins@sapphirehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-26T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sapphire Health: CAIQ mapping workshop & artifact sprint plan

Quick note — Jordan / team, thanks for the agenda and draft playbook. I’ll be there Tue and can help validate artifact sufficiency from a third-party perspective. If possible, we’d like a quick look at backup retention and MFA enforcement on the admin plane during the workshop.

Thanks,
Tom
SecVendor — Security Advisory
